t: Din ek yitnaheg hayyachid lekavven bitpillato im hatztzibbur
s: Din ek yitnaheg hayyachid lekavven bitpillato im hatztzibbur ubo h' seipim: hanniknas lebet hakkeneset umatza tzibbur mitpalelin y"ch (shel mincha) veen hashshaa oberet adayin, im yakol lehatchil y"ch veligmor ad shello yaggia hashsheliach tzibbur liqdushsha — yitpallel, veim lav — al yitpallel ad sheyyaaneh amen achar "hael haqqadosh", sheamen zeh chashub kiqdushsha. Veim shama kebar qedushsha o sheyyodea sheyyishma achar kak — en tzarik lehamtin. Veim matza hatztzibbur mitpallelin arbit, im yakol lehatchil veligmor ad sheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur leqaddish shelleachar y"ch beinyan sheyyukal laanot acharayv "yehe shemeh rabba" al derek shennitbaer besiman n"v apillu im lo yukal laanot "amen yehe shemeh rabba" kemo shennitbaer sham — yitpallel, veim lav — al yitpallel ap al pi sheshshama kebar qaddish bearbit, lepi shehaqqaddish en lo qitzba. Umikkol maqom, haqqaddishim shemmin "alenu" veelak, ben bashshachar ben baereb, kevan sheenan ella minhag — epshar sheen tzarik lehamtin alehem. Abal im poresim al "shema" vehu lo shama adayin "bareku" — tzarik lehamtin bishbil "bareku", vaapillu im omerim oto belo qaddish kegon bearbit:

Veim niknas lebet hakkeneset achar qedushsha, o shenniknas qodem laken vehimtin ad leachar kak, im yakol lehatchil veligmor ad sheyyaggia hashsheliach tzibbur le"shomea tepilla" bikde sheyyukal laanot amen achar birkat "shomea tepilla" sheamen zeh gam ken chashub kiqdushsha veqaddish — yitpallel, veim lav — al yitpallel ad leachar "modim". Veken beshabbat veyom tob umusap rosh chodesh sheen bahem amen shel "shomea tepilla" — lo yitpallel ella im ken yakol ligmor qodem sheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur le"modim", kede sheyyishcheh im hatztzibbur be"modim", sheim hem yikreu vehu lo yikra immahem — yehe nireh kekoper bemi shechaberayv koreim umishtachavim lo (veken bekol maqom shehatztzibbur koreim umishtachavim kegon be"alenu"). Vehu haddin im yakol lehaggia le"modim", o leachat mehabberakot sheshshochim bahen kesheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur le"modim" — yitpallel. Veap al pi shello yakol lomar "modim" shehatztzibbur omerim — en bekak kelum, kevan sheshshocheh immahem. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemusap o bemincha, o apillu bitpillat shacharit umamtin qodem chatimat "gaal yisrael". Abal im amar ad "gaal yisrael" sheeno yakol od lehamtin velaanot mishshum semikat geulla litpilla umukrach lehatchil ulehitpallel miyyad venizdammen lo shemmaggia sheliach tzibbur le"modim" vehu beachat habberakot beemtzaan — yishcheh immo, shemmuttar lishchot beemtza kol habberakot. Abal im eno mukrach lehatchil miyyad — lo yatchil al semak sheyyishcheh beemtza ezo beraka, ki shemma lo yukal letzamtzem sheyyihyeh beemtza beraka keshemmaggia sheliach tzibbur le"modim" ella yihyeh bitchillat beraka o besopah veen shochin bitchillat beraka o besopah ella beabot vehodaa bilbad kemo sheyyitbaer besiman (ql"g) [qy"g], veim yitten libbo letzamtzem bazeh — yittared velo yekavven yapeh bitpillato:

Ukeshehu mukrach lehatchil miyyad umatchil im hashsheliach tzibbur, kesheyyaggia im sheliach tzibbur le"naqdishak" o li"neqaddesh" kepi nussach medinot ellu — yomar immo milla bemilla kol nussach haqqedushsha kemo shehu omer, sheap sheen hayyachid omer qedushsha bitpillato — keshehu omer im hashsheliach tzibbur eno niqra yachid. Veken yomar immo milla bemilla kol nussach birkat "hael haqqadosh" ubirkat "shomea tepilla", kede sheyyesayyem habberaka im hashsheliach tzibbur beyachad, veshub en tzarik laanot amen, kemo shehashsheliach tzibbur en tzarik shehatztzibbur onim acharayv, vaaniyyat hatztzibbur hi gam ken al berakot shel zeh. Vegam yekavven shekkesheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur le"modim" yaggia gam hu le"modim" o le"hattob shimka", kede sheyyishcheh gam hu im hatztzibbur be"modim". Veim yakol ligmor kol hattepilla ad sheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur lesiyyum "shomea tepilla" — yakol lehitpallel bipne atzmo achar siyyum "hael haqqadosh". Vekol zeh keshemmukrach lehitpallel miyyad mishshum semikat geulla litpilla, o mippene shehashshaa oberet, abal im eno mukrach — lo yatchil im hashsheliach tzibbur velomar immo nussach haqqedushsha, lepi shellekattechilla tzarik lishtoq velishmoa nussach haqqedushsha mippi hashsheliach tzibbur velaanot acharayv "qadosh" u"baruk" ve"yimlok" bilbad, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qk"h:

Mi shebba lebet hakkeneset tekep achar qedushsha, veim yamtin ad achar sheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur le"modim" lo yukal laanot "amen yehe shemeh rabba" (achar haqqaddish) sheachar y"ch, veim yamtin ad achar haqqaddish yaabor zeman hattepilla o lo yukal lehitpallel arbit im hatztzibbur — yatchil miyyad, shemmutab lebattel "modim" millebattel "amen yehe shemeh rabba". Vehu haddin im ba samuk liqdushsha, veim yatchil miyyad lo yukal lomar qedushsha, veim yamtin ad achar qedushsha lo yukal lomar "modim", veim yamtin ad achar "modim" yaabor zeman hattepilla — yatchil achar qedushsha, shemmutab lebattel "modim" miqqedushsha im hatztzibbur. Veim ba samuk laqqaddish, veim yitpallel tekep yebattel "amen yehe shemeh rabba", veim yamtin ad achar qaddish lo yukal lehitpallel arbit im hatztzibbur — mutab lehitpallel im hatztzibbur:

Yachid haomed bitpillat y"ch ukeshemmaggia limqom qedushsha hayu hatztzibbur omerim qedushshat "uba letziyyon" o qedushshat "yotzer" — eno omer immahem qadosh, lepi sheen haqqedushshot shavot. Veyesh mi sheomer shehu haddin im haya hatztzibbur omerim qedushshat musap vehayyachid mitpallel shacharit — eno omer immahem "qadosh", sheen haqqedushshot shavot. Veyesh omerim sheqqedushshat shacharit uqedushshat musap niqraot qedushshot shavot, mah sheen ken qedushshat "uba letziyyon" uqedushshat "yotzer" sheenan ella sippur debarim kemo shennitbaer besiman n"t. Veken iqqar. (Umikkan atta lamed shehayyachid keshemmaggia bitpillato lebirkat "atta qadosh" — yakol laanot qadosh im hatztzibbur ap al pi shehu lo amar velo shama "neqaddesh" o "naqdishak" mippi hashsheliach tzibbur, shehare qedushshat "yotzer" "uba letziyyon" en bahem "neqaddesh" veap al pi ken lo menauhu ella mippene sheen haqqedushshot shavot):
